answer: If your divorce decree awards the car to you, bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed; otherwise your ex has to sign, the same as any co-owner. An owner who can't come to the appointment can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically with no notary, except in Georgia, where it must be notarized. For the name mismatch, bring the document that shows your name change, such as the divorce decree or a court order. You'll also sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
